3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 22-year-old female received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 19 November 2024. Approximately 11 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Pericarditis. The patient sought medical attention and was managed outpatient. The outcome was recovering. The reporter considers the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
